subject: Demo touchpoint — Stratigo roadmap shift and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@stratigo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stratigo intro + demo availability

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to get a short demo on the calendar to show a focused workflow for reducing inference cost on your customer-facing summarization pipeline.

I have the following 30-minute windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 6/22 11:00–11:30
- Wed 6/23 14:00–14:30
- Thu 6/24 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, tell me a couple of slots that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attached is a two-page quickstart that outlines the demo plan and the data we’d like to use (non-prod). No commitment — just a short technical walkthrough + Q&A.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)]

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@stratigo.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: CTO Office <cto@stratigo.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratigo intro + demo availability

Marissa —

Thanks for the follow up and the quickstart. I’m afraid we need to pause scheduling for the moment. Our product org has just re-prioritized the workstreams for H2 and the LLM/inference initiative has been pushed down the roadmap while we focus on a major data migration and a sales enablement rollout. Additionally, our VP of Product will be out traveling for the next six weeks which makes coordination tricky.

Could you hold off on formal demos for now? We value the conversation but need to conserve pilot resources until we have capacity again. I expect we’ll be able to revisit in Q4 — I can ping you once internal timelines firm up.

If anything changes sooner I’ll let you know. Appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Sr. Product Manager — Customer Experience
Aisha.Khan@stratigo.com | +1 (617) 555-6670

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratigo intro + demo availability

Hi Aisha —

Totally understand — thanks for the clear heads-up. We’ll pause scheduling on our side and keep the quickstart and notes on file.

A couple of quick things that may be helpful while this is deprioritized:
- I’ll share the demo recording and the two-slide summary that shows expected token cost reductions for your current pipeline (no live environment required).
- We can reserve a small credit package so you have a ready sandbox when timelines reopen; happy to discuss limits and timing later.
- Can we agree I’ll check back in early October to see if timelines have shifted? If you prefer a different month, say which quarter and I’ll set a reminder.

If you want to share the specific migration window dates or any technical blockers, Priyom can do a short async write-up on compatibility constraints (KV cache, latency SLO impacts).

Thanks again, and wishing you a smooth migration.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Stratigo — mark deprioritized, follow-up plan

Marissa / Priyom —

Thanks for looping us. Per Aisha, this is a product-driven de-scope for H2 + VP travel. Action items: 
- Mark deal STRAT-2027-06 as "deprioritized" in HubSpot and set next-touch for 2027-10-03.
- Offer a cold-storage credit bundle (CS-10) we can apply if they want a sandbox later — keep the offer ready but don’t push.
- Priyom: please draft a one-pager on migration compatibility (quick notes on KV cache warmup and recommended quantization profiles) so we can attach it to the record.
- Marissa: hold any active calendar invites; if they re-open earlier, we’ll be ready to run a short 20–30 min session.

Attaching our internal deal notes and a snapshot of the customer roadmap that Aisha shared.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales — West
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: internal-deal-notes.docx (docx, 95 KB)]
